title: An Explicit Representation of the Dominant Eigenstructure for Positive Operators on Banach Lattices
summary: The Riesz projection and the corresponding eigenfunction of a positive operator satisfying the Doeblin condition are explicitly constructed using the partial Bell polynomials. While classical Fredholm theory requires stringent summability conditions, such as the operator being in a Schatten class to ensure the convergence of Fredholm minors, our approach utilizes the local algebraic structure induced by the Doeblin condition. We define a scalar function $D(λ)$ whose derivative $D'(λ_0)$ at the dominant eigenvalue $λ_0$ naturally provides the normalization constant for the projection.…
